what_changed: Marlow Metalworks cannot ship PO-5520 (200 BL-12 boilers) as a single 200-unit shipment on day 7 as originally scheduled; they offer either a split shipment of 80 on day 7 and 120 on day 21 (Option A), or the full 200 units together on day 13 (Option B, six days late).

options.name: Option A: 80 on day 7, 120 on day 21

decisions_for_a_person: Choose between Option A (risks order O-2205, 4 days late, late_penalty applies) and Option B (risks order O-2203, 1 day late, late_penalty applies) within 3 business days, or the supplier will default to Option B.
Consider which late-penalty order is more costly/important to protect: O-2203 (50 units, 40 short, 1 day late) vs O-2205 (25 units, 5 short, 4 days late).
supplier_questions: Which shipping option (A or B) would you like for PO-5520?
